title: Equilibria and Learning in Competitive Market Making
abstract: arXiv:2610.30891v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a market-making game played among $N \ge 2$ strategic market makers and a single non-strategic representative trader. In a continuous quote space, standard finite-game arguments do not apply, while non-convex and discontinuous payoffs rule out classical continuous existence results and complicate learning. Nonetheless, we characterize pure-strategy Nash equilibria (PSNEs) and show that at least one PSNE always exists under minimal assumptions on the underlying asset value distribution, and that the equilibrium bid-ask spread widens strictly with asset value volatility. To obtain a tractable learning framework, we discretize prices and, under an additional regularity condition, show that the time-averaged play of no-internal-regret learners approaches the continuous Nash price envelope as the tick size vanishes. Finally, we empirically validate our theoretical results through numerical simulations.

translated_title: 竞争性做市中的均衡与学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个在 N ≥ 2 个策略性做市商与单个非策略性代表性交易者之间进行的做市博弈。在连续报价空间中，标准的有限博弈论证并不适用，而非凸且不连续的收益函数排除了经典的连续性存在性结果，并使学习问题复杂化。尽管如此，我们刻画了纯策略纳什均衡（PSNE），并证明在对比标资产价值分布的极小假设下，至少总存在一个纯策略纳什均衡，且均衡买卖价差随资产价值波动率的增大而严格变宽。为了获得一个易于处理的学习框架，我们对价格进行离散化，并在附加的正则性条件下证明：当最小报价单位趋于零时，无内部遗憾学习者的时间平均策略收敛于连续纳什价格包络。最后，我们通过数值模拟对理论结果进行了实证验证。
tldr: 本文提出了多策略做市商与代表性交易者之间的做市博弈模型，证明了纯策略纳什均衡在极弱假设下总是存在且买卖价差随波动率严格变宽，并进一步证明当报价单位趋于零时无内部遗憾学习者的时间平均策略收敛于连续纳什均衡价格包络。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a market-making game among multiple strategic market makers and a representative trader, proves that pure-strategy Nash equilibria always exist under minimal assumptions with bid-ask spreads strictly widening with volatility, and shows that the time-averaged play of no-internal-regret learners converges to the continuous Nash price envelope as the tick size vanishes.
